script:
#Тикет - ISS-2025-01030
#Кастомный Серверный метод необходим из-за сложностей обращения к дочерней таблице в Supplier
log("_________________ Check User Affiliation _________________")
    
# Получаем параметры
args = frappe.form_dict
user = args.get('user')

# Кэш для оптимизации
cache = {
    'employee_check': None,
    'supplier_check': None
}

# 1. Проверка Employee
def check_employee():
    if cache['employee_check'] is not None:
        return cache['employee_check']
        
    employee = frappe.db.get_value('Employee', {'user_id': user}, 'name')
    cache['employee_check'] = employee
    return employee

# 2. Проверка Supplier через Portal User
def check_supplier():
    if cache['supplier_check'] is not None:
        return cache['supplier_check']
        
    supplier = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT parent 
        FROM `tabPortal User` 
        WHERE parenttype = 'Supplier' AND user = %s
        LIMIT 1
    """, user, as_dict=True)
    
    cache['supplier_check'] = supplier[0].parent if supplier else None
    return cache['supplier_check']

# Основная логика проверки
result = {
    'user': user,
    'is_employee': bool(check_employee()),
    'is_supplier': bool(check_supplier()),
    'employee': cache['employee_check'],
    'supplier': cache['supplier_check']
}

frappe.response["message"] = result

name: Comm_Issue_Data_Auto_Filling
script:
# Тикет -- https://erp.dinord.ru/app/issue/ISS-2025-01841 -- вариант без try-except
# Объединенный скрипт для события After Insert на Communication
# Объединяет логику авто-проекта и парсинга данных из сообщения

if doc.reference_doctype == 'Issue' and frappe.db.exists("Issue", doc.reference_name):
    issue = frappe.get_doc("Issue", doc.reference_name)
    need_save = False
    assigned_to = None
    
    # === ЛОГИКА ИЗ СКРИПТА 1: Авто-назначение проекта ===
    # settings = frappe.get_doc("Additional Settings", "Project Settings in Support Issues")
    settings = frappe.get_doc("Projects Email Mapping")
    
    active_settings = [setting for setting in settings.setting_table if setting.enabled]
    
    # Обработка получателей
    if doc.recipients:
        recipients = [r.strip() for r in doc.recipients.split("\n") if r.strip()]
        
        for message in recipients:
            for setting in active_settings:
                if setting.st_email and setting.st_email in message:
                    issue.project = setting.st_project
                    need_save = True
                    break

    # Обработка копий
    if doc.cc:
        cc_recipients = [cc.strip() for cc in doc.cc.split("\n") if cc.strip()]
        
        for cc_message in cc_recipients:
            for setting in active_settings:
                if setting.st_email and setting.st_email in cc_message:
                    issue.project = setting.st_project
                    need_save = True
                    break

    # === ЕДИНСТВЕННОЕ СОХРАНЕНИЕ ISSUE ===
    if need_save:
        issue.save(ignore_permissions=True)
        
    # === СОЗДАНИЕ TODO (после сохранения Issue) ===
    if assigned_to:
        existing_todo = frappe.db.exists("ToDo", {
            'allocated_to': assigned_to,
            'reference_type': 'Issue',
            'reference_name': doc.reference_name,
            'status': 'Open'
        })
        
        if not existing_todo:
            todo_data = {
                'doctype': 'ToDo',
                'allocated_to': assigned_to,
                'reference_type': 'Issue',
                'reference_name': doc.reference_name,
                'description': _('Автоматическое назначение'),
                'status': 'Open'
            }
            todo = frappe.get_doc(todo_data)
            todo.insert()
            
            existing_docshare = frappe.db.exists("DocShare", {
                'share_doctype': "Issue",
                'share_name': doc.reference_name,
                'user': assigned_to
            })
            
            if not existing_docshare:
                new_docshare = frappe.new_doc("DocShare")
                new_docshare.share_doctype = "Issue"
                new_docshare.share_name = doc.reference_name
                new_docshare.user = assigned_to
                new_docshare.read = 1
                new_docshare.write = 1
                new_docshare.save(ignore_permissions=True)

name: Meeting Notes  в Task
script:
# === Поля в Meeting Notes ===
PARENT_PROJECT_FIELD = "project"        # Link → Project
ASSIGNMENTS_TABLE    = "assignments"    # child-таблица Assignments

# === Поля строки Assignments ===
F_SUBJECT      = "assignment"           # → Task.subject
F_DESC         = "description"          # → Task.description
F_RESP         = "responsible"          # Link → User
F_DUE          = "date"                 # → Task.exp_end_date
F_PARENT_TASK  = "parent_task"          # Link → Task (родитель)
F_CREATED_TASK = "task"                 # Link → Task (сюда пишем созданную, чтобы не дублировать)

project = doc.get(PARENT_PROJECT_FIELD)

# проверяем, есть ли поле meeting_notes в Task (без getattr/hasattr)
has_meeting_notes = False
meta_task = frappe.get_meta("Task")
if meta_task and meta_task.fields:
    for df in meta_task.fields:
        # df.fieldname доступен как атрибут
        if df.fieldname == "meeting_notes":
            has_meeting_notes = True
            break

if project:
    rows = doc.get(ASSIGNMENTS_TABLE) or []
    for row in rows:
        # не создаём дубль
        if row.get(F_CREATED_TASK):
            continue

        # subject / description / due / responsible
        subject_val = frappe.utils.cstr(row.get(F_SUBJECT)) or ""
        subject_val = subject_val.strip()
        if not subject_val:
            subject_val = "Action from " + (frappe.utils.cstr(doc.get("name") or "Meeting Notes"))

        task_desc = frappe.utils.cstr(row.get(F_DESC)) or ""
        task_desc = task_desc.strip()
        if not task_desc:
            task_desc = subject_val

        due_date = row.get(F_DUE)
        user_to_assign = row.get(F_RESP)  # Link → User

        # подзадача
        parent_task = row.get(F_PARENT_TASK)
        task_project = project
        if parent_task:
            vals = frappe.db.get_value("Task", parent_task, ["project", "is_group"])
            if vals:
                parent_proj = vals[0]
                parent_is_group = vals[1]
                if parent_proj:
                    task_project = parent_proj
                if not parent_is_group:
                    frappe.db.set_value("Task", parent_task, "is_group", 1, update_modified=False)

        # собираем данные новой задачи
        task_values = {
            "doctype": "Task",
            "subject": subject_val,
            "description": task_desc,
            "project": task_project,
            "status": "Open",
            "parent_task": parent_task or None,
            "exp_end_date": due_date if due_date else None,
        }
        if has_meeting_notes:
            task_values["meeting_notes"] = doc.name  # обратная ссылка, если поле есть

        # создаём Task
        task = frappe.get_doc(task_values).insert()

        # назначаем исполнителя через ToDo (простой и надёжный способ)
        if user_to_assign:
            frappe.get_doc({
                "doctype": "ToDo",
                "allocated_to": user_to_assign,
                "reference_type": "Task",
                "reference_name": task.name,
                "status": "Open",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "date": frappe.utils.nowdate(),
                "description": subject_val
            }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

        # пишем ссылку обратно в строку Assignments
        row.set(F_CREATED_TASK, task.name)

def get_project_dashboard_data(project):
    if not project:
        frappe.throw("Parameter 'project' is required")

    #
    # 1) TOTAL TASKS (быстро, использует индекс)
    #
    row = frappe.db.sql(
        "SELECT COUNT(1) AS c FROM `tabTask` "
        "WHERE project=%s AND docstatus!=2",
        (project,), as_dict=True
    )
    total_tasks = int(row[0]["c"]) if row else 0

    #
    # 2) TASKS BY STATUS
    #
    status_rows = frappe.db.sql(
        "SELECT IFNULL(status, '') AS k, COUNT(1) AS c "
        "FROM `tabTask` "
        "WHERE project=%s AND docstatus!=2 "
        "GROUP BY status",
        (project,), as_dict=True
    )

    #
    # 3) TASKS BY PRIORITY
    #
    priority_rows = frappe.db.sql(
        "SELECT IFNULL(priority, '') AS k, COUNT(1) AS c "
        "FROM `tabTask` "
        "WHERE project=%s AND docstatus!=2 "
        "GROUP BY priority",
        (project,), as_dict=True
    )

    #
    # 4) ISSUES BY TYPE
    #
    issue_rows = frappe.db.sql(
        "SELECT IFNULL(issue_type, '') AS k, COUNT(1) AS c "
        "FROM `tabIssue` "
        "WHERE project=%s AND docstatus!=2 "
        "GROUP BY issue_type",
        (project,), as_dict=True
    )

    #
    # 5) UNASSIGNED TASKS — быстрый отдельный подсчёт
    #
    unassigned_row = frappe.db.sql(
        "SELECT COUNT(1) AS c "
        "FROM `tabTask` "
        "WHERE project=%s AND docstatus!=2 "
        "  AND (_assign IS NULL OR TRIM(_assign)='')",
        (project,), as_dict=True
    )
    unassigned_cnt = int(unassigned_row[0]["c"]) if unassigned_row else 0

    #
    # 6) ASSIGNEES: читаем ВСЕ _assign одной операцией
    #    и парсим вручную БЕЗ import json
    #
    assign_rows = frappe.db.sql(
        "SELECT _assign FROM `tabTask` "
        "WHERE project=%s AND docstatus!=2",
        (project,), as_dict=True
    )

    assignee_counts = {}    # {user: count}
    # простая функция для парсинга JSON-списка строк
    # поддерживает стандартный формат: ["a","b"]
    def parse_assign(raw):
        if not raw:
            return []
        s = raw.strip()
        if not s:
            return []
        if not (s.startswith("[") and s.endswith("]")):
            return []
        inner = s[1:-1].strip()
        if not inner:
            return []
        parts = inner.split(",")
        users = []
        i = 0
        total = len(parts)
        while i < total:
            p = parts[i].strip()
            if p.startswith('"') and not p.endswith('"'):
                j = i + 1
                while j < total and not parts[j].strip().endswith('"'):
                    j = j + 1
                if j < total:
                    merged = ""
                    for k in range(i, j + 1):
                        if merged:
                            merged = merged + ","
                        merged = merged + parts[k]
                    p = merged.strip()
                    i = j
            if p.startswith('"') and p.endswith('"'):
                val = p[1:-1].strip()
                if val:
                    users.append(val)
            i = i + 1
        return users

    # считаем исполнителей
    for r in assign_rows:
        raw = r.get("_assign") or ""
        lst = parse_assign(raw)
        for user in lst:
            if user not in assignee_counts:
                assignee_counts[user] = 1
            else:
                assignee_counts[user] = assignee_counts[user] + 1

    # добавляем "Не задан" как отдельный ключ
    if unassigned_cnt > 0:
        assignee_counts["__UNASSIGNED__"] = unassigned_cnt

    #
    # Загружаем full_name для всех асайни
    #
    assignee_keys = []
    for k in assignee_counts:
        if k != "__UNASSIGNED__":
            assignee_keys.append(k)

    user_full = {}
    if assignee_keys:
        placeholders = ",".join(["%s"] * len(assignee_keys))
        rows = frappe.db.sql(
            "SELECT name, IFNULL(full_name, name) AS fn "
            "FROM `tabUser` WHERE name IN (" + placeholders + ")",
            tuple(assignee_keys),
            as_dict=True
        )
        for u in rows:
            user_full[u["name"]] = u["fn"]

    # формируем структуру для вывода
    tasks_by_assignee = {"keys": [], "labels": [], "counts": []}

    # сортируем по убыванию количества
    items = list(assignee_counts.items())
    items.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])

    for user, cnt in items:
        if user == "__UNASSIGNED__":
            label = _("Не задано")
            key = ""
        else:
            label = user_full.get(user) or user
            key = user
        tasks_by_assignee["keys"].append(key)
        tasks_by_assignee["labels"].append(label)
        tasks_by_assignee["counts"].append(cnt)

    #
    # финальная структура
    #
    tasks_by_status = {
        "labels": [(r["k"] or _("Не задано")) for r in status_rows],
        "counts": [int(r["c"]) for r in status_rows]
    }

    tasks_by_priority = {
        "labels": [(r["k"] or _("Не задано")) for r in priority_rows],
        "counts": [int(r["c"]) for r in priority_rows]
    }

    issues_by_type = {
        "labels": [(r["k"] or _("Не задано")) for r in issue_rows],
        "counts": [int(r["c"]) for r in issue_rows]
    }

    result = {
        "total_tasks": total_tasks,
        "tasks_by_status": tasks_by_status,
        "tasks_by_priority": tasks_by_priority,
        "tasks_by_assignee": tasks_by_assignee,
        "issues_by_type": issues_by_type,
        "raw": {
            "status": status_rows,
            "priority": priority_rows,
            "assignee": items,
            "issue": issue_rows
        }
    }

    return result

log("_________________ Get Project Metrics _________________")
    
project = frappe.form_dict.project

frappe.response.message = get_project_dashboard_data( project )

name: Project_Cost_Center_Update
script:
#Тикет - ISS-2025-01030
# Тикет -- https://erp.dinord.ru/app/issue/ISS-2025-01841

today = frappe.utils.nowdate()

# Получаем все записи из Cost Center Table
all_records = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT parent, cct_cost_center, cct_valid_from
    FROM `tabCost Center Table`
    WHERE parenttype = 'Project' 
        AND cct_valid_from IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY parent, cct_valid_from
""", as_dict=True)

# Группируем по проектам
project_records = {}
for record in all_records:
    project = record.parent
    if project not in project_records:
        project_records[project] = []
    project_records[project].append({
        'cost_center': record.cct_cost_center,
        'valid_from': record.cct_valid_from
    })

today_date = frappe.utils.getdate(today)

for project_name, records in project_records.items():
    if not records:
        continue
        
    # Находим ближайшую дату
    closest_record = None
    min_diff = None
    
    for rec in records:
        valid_from = rec['valid_from']
        if not valid_from:
            continue
            
        record_date = frappe.utils.getdate(valid_from)
        diff = abs((record_date - today_date).days)
        
        if min_diff is None or diff < min_diff:
            min_diff = diff
            closest_record = rec
    
    if closest_record:
        new_cost_center = closest_record['cost_center']
        current_cost_center = frappe.db.get_value("Project", project_name, "cost_center")
        
        if current_cost_center != new_cost_center:
            frappe.db.set_value("Project", project_name, "cost_center", new_cost_center)

name: Task_Actual_Dates_Sync
script:
# Нормализует даты Task по фактическим данным:
# - для незавершенной задачи факт может только расширять прогнозные даты;
# - для Completed completed_on и exp_* синхронизируются с act_*.

act_start_date = doc.get("act_start_date")
act_end_date = doc.get("act_end_date")

if doc.status == "Completed":
    # ISS-2025-02606:
    # На сервере подставляем completed_on только из act_end_date.
    # UX-подстановка на форме живет в client script, а здесь оставляем
    # серверный fallback рядом с основной синхронизацией дат Task.
    if act_end_date and not doc.completed_on:
        doc.completed_on = act_end_date

    # Если completed_on уже есть, но она раньше фактической даты завершения,
    # дотягиваем ее до act_end_date по исходному правилу тикета.
    if act_end_date and (not doc.completed_on or frappe.utils.getdate(doc.completed_on) < frappe.utils.getdate(act_end_date)):
        doc.completed_on = act_end_date

    # Для завершенной задачи плановые даты приравниваем к фактическим, если факт есть.
    if act_start_date:
        doc.exp_start_date = act_start_date

    if act_end_date:
        doc.exp_end_date = act_end_date
else:
    # Для незавершенной задачи факт может только расширять плановые границы,
    # но не сужать их.
    if act_start_date and (not doc.exp_start_date or frappe.utils.getdate(doc.exp_start_date) > frappe.utils.getdate(act_start_date)):
        doc.exp_start_date = act_start_date

    if act_end_date and (not doc.exp_end_date or frappe.utils.getdate(doc.exp_end_date) < frappe.utils.getdate(act_end_date)):
        doc.exp_end_date = act_end_date

# ISS-2025-02606 (п.2): если после синхронизации плановый период задачи выходит за рамки
# родителя по иерархии parent_task — расширяем прогнозные даты по всей цепочке вверх.
# Делаем это напрямую через db.set_value, чтобы не упираться в validate родителя,
# где ERPNext проверяет дочерние expected dates относительно следующего предка.
parent_task = doc.get("parent_task")
if parent_task:
    gd = frappe.utils.getdate
    c_start = doc.get("exp_start_date")
    c_end = doc.get("exp_end_date")
    current_parent = parent_task
    visited = set()

    while current_parent and current_parent not in visited and (c_start or c_end):
        visited.add(current_parent)
        parent_data = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Task",
            current_parent,
            ["status", "parent_task", "exp_start_date", "exp_end_date"],
            as_dict=True,
        )
        if not parent_data:
            break

        p_status = parent_data.get("status")
        if p_status == "Cancelled":
            break

        p_start = parent_data.get("exp_start_date")
        p_end = parent_data.get("exp_end_date")
        new_start = p_start
        new_end = p_end
        vals = {}

        if c_start and (not p_start or gd(c_start) < gd(p_start)):
            new_start = c_start
            vals["exp_start_date"] = c_start

        if c_end and (not p_end or gd(c_end) > gd(p_end)):
            new_end = c_end
            vals["exp_end_date"] = c_end

        if not vals:
            break

        frappe.db.set_value("Task", current_parent, vals)
        c_start = new_start
        c_end = new_end
        current_parent = parent_data.get("parent_task")
